analyses_kind_check.name: analyses_kind_check
analyses_kind_check.value: "analyses"."kind" in ('same_witness', 'cross_witness') and ("analyses"."kind" = 'cross_witness') = ("analyses"."witness_b_id" is not null) and ("analyses"."kind" = 'same_witness' or ("analyses"."retrieval" = 'direct_fable' and "analyses"."witness_b_id" <> "analyses"."witness_id"))

depositions_excluded_check.name: depositions_excluded_check
depositions_excluded_check.value: ("depositions"."excluded_reason" is null or "depositions"."excluded_reason" in ('legacy_parse', 'duplicate', 'misfiled')) and ("depositions"."excluded_reason" is not distinct from 'duplicate') = ("depositions"."duplicate_of" is not null) and "depositions"."duplicate_of" is distinct from "depositions"."id"

depositions_read_check.name: depositions_read_check
depositions_read_check.value: ("depositions"."validation" is null) = ("depositions"."page_count" is null) and ("depositions"."validation" is not null or "depositions"."status"::text in ('processing', 'failed'))

exchange_lines_segments_check.name: exchange_lines_segments_check
exchange_lines_segments_check.value: ("exchange_lines"."segment_from" is null) = ("exchange_lines"."segment_to" is null) and ("exchange_lines"."segment_from" is null or "exchange_lines"."segment_from" between 0 and "exchange_lines"."segment_to")

exchanges_evidence_fields_check.name: exchanges_evidence_fields_check
exchanges_evidence_fields_check.value: ("exchanges"."evidence_key" is null) = ("exchanges"."text_hash" is null) and ("exchanges"."evidence_key" is null) = ("exchanges"."speaker_status" is null)

facts_indexed_check.name: facts_indexed_check
facts_indexed_check.value: "facts"."status" <> 'indexed' or ("facts"."source_verification" in ('verified', 'approximate') and "facts"."attribution_status" <> 'invalid' and "facts"."rejection_reason" is null and "facts"."factual_dimension" is not null and "facts"."evidence_phrase" is not null)

findings_score_check.name: findings_score_check
findings_score_check.value: ("findings"."score" is null) = ("findings"."band" is null) and ("findings"."score" is null or "findings"."score" between 0 and 100)

llm_calls_priced_check.name: llm_calls_priced_check
llm_calls_priced_check.value: ("llm_calls"."cost_usd" is null) = ("llm_calls"."price_version" is null) and ("llm_calls"."cost_usd" is null or "llm_calls"."cost_usd" >= 0)

screening_entries_consolidated_check.name: screening_entries_consolidated_check
screening_entries_consolidated_check.value: ("screening_entries"."screen_status" = 'consolidated') = ("screening_entries"."consolidated_into" is not null) and ("screening_entries"."screen_status" = 'consolidated') = ("screening_entries"."rank" is null)

statement_cards_usable_check.name: statement_cards_usable_check
statement_cards_usable_check.value: "statement_cards"."status"::text <> 'usable' or ("statement_cards"."exchange_id" is not null and "statement_cards"."first_line_id" is not null and "statement_cards"."last_line_id" is not null and "statement_cards"."source_phrase" is not null and "statement_cards"."statement" is not null and "statement_cards"."event" is not null and "statement_cards"."subject" is not null and "statement_cards"."predicate" is not null and "statement_cards"."stance" is not null and "statement_cards"."epistemic" is not null)

verdicts_origin_check.name: verdicts_origin_check
verdicts_origin_check.value: "verdicts"."origin" in ('model', 'replayed', 'fixture') and ("verdicts"."origin" = 'model') = ("verdicts"."llm_call_id" is not null) and ("verdicts"."origin" = 'replayed') = ("verdicts"."replay_of" is not null)
